name: Canadian Premier Life Insurance Company (operating as Securian Canada)
ownership: Wholly owned subsidiary of Securian Financial Group, Inc. (St. Paul, MN; mutual holding company structure; unlisted). Sister company Canadian Premier General Insurance Company; Valeyo Inc. services affiliate

metrics.source: data/osfi/balance_sheet_assets.csv (OSFI LF1, Canadian Premier Life Insurance Company)
metrics.note: 1,068.5 at 2025-12-31; 1,217.1 at 2024-12-31. No published financial statements; Securian Canada refers users to OSFI's financial data pages (https://www.securiancanada.ca/important-disclosures).
Bonds 460.7 (public corporates 342.3, federal 87.7, provincial 23.4, municipal 7.3), common shares 177.2 (incl. equities backing UL accounts), preferreds 5.8, short-term 23.3. 827.0 at 2024-12-31.
No segregated funds; no asset-management arm in Canada. Parent's general account C$38.8bn (Securian, 2025).
FY2025; 989.9 FY2024. Insurance service result FY2025 C$11.5mm; net investment result C$17.4mm.
Trade-press company profile; ranked 13th in Canadian L&H market share (MSA Research, 2024). Covers both Canadian Premier Life and General.

vs +C$0.3mm FY2024. 'Other income and expenses' swung from -C$30.8mm (9M 2025) to -C$137.8mm (FY), and goodwill of C$96.5mm carried through 2025 Q3 is nil at 2025 Q4: consistent with a Q4 2025 goodwill write-off of ~C$96.5mm (inferred; not confirmed by any company statement).
vs -C$12.9mm H1 2025. No core/underlying earnings measure; company publishes no earnings.

Core 118.2%. 2025-12-31: total 163.9% / core 127.0%; 2024-12-31 public disclosure: total 153% / core 124% (available capital C$293.5mm, BSB C$250.7mm). Ratio rose despite the 2025 loss because goodwill is already deducted from Tier 1 and the base solvency buffer fell to C$217.9mm (inferred from OSFI data).

No debt disclosed at the Canadian entity. Tier 2 capital C$60.3mm (2026 Q2) could include subordinated instruments from the parent but composition is not disclosed. Parent SFG has US$500mm 4.8% senior notes due 2048.

Affirmed 2025-12-04; BCAR moved to 'strongest' from 'very strong'; growing strategic importance to parent. Parent Minnesota Life/Securian Life: AM Best A+, Fitch AA, Moody's Aa3, S&P AA- (all affirmed 2025, https://www.securian.com/about-us/financial-strength.html). No S&P/Moody's/DBRS rating on the Canadian entity found.

No investment function disclosed in Canada; leadership page lists CEO, CFO, CTO/CISO, CHXO, CLO only. Parent's Securian Asset Management (St. Paul) runs ~US$40bn incl. the group general account; whether it manages Canadian Premier's portfolio is not disclosed.
Wikipedia also says 300+. Offices Toronto (HQ, 25 Sheppard Ave W), Montreal, Burnaby, Waterloo, Winnipeg.
Sun Life Sponsored Markets deal added 100+ client organizations and 1.5mm insureds; profile cites 'more than 6,000 credit unions, banks and finance companies' partner reach (North America).

business_mix.basis: OSFI LF3 insurance contract liabilities by line, Canada, 2025-12-31 (no segment earnings or premium split published by the company; the OSFI 10A premium return in the repo stops at FY2022).
business_mix.note: Group insurance liabilities C$528.0mm; individual insurance is a net contract asset of C$47.9mm (so shown as 0%). Business lines: credit card balance protection, mortgage/loan protection via banks, credit unions, finance companies and auto/RV dealers (Armour Group); association & affinity (CAA, student health plans) and legacy individual life/UL. AM Best (Dec 2025): growing in finance-company and auto-dealer markets.

pm_structure.summary: Not disclosed. Securian Canada publishes no financial statements and names no investment officer; the OSFI balance sheet shows a C$0.67bn portfolio of public corporate and government bonds plus C$0.18bn of common shares (incl. UL-backing equities). The parent's captive manager, Securian Asset Management (St. Paul; fixed income, private credit, CRE, LDI), runs the group general account, so delegation to it is plausible but unconfirmed.
manager_entities: Not disclosed (parent affiliate Securian Asset Management is the likely manager; inferred)
bullets: No CIO, investment committee or manager named in any Canadian disclosure (leadership page, LICAT, B-15 report)
OSFI LF1: bonds fell to C$461mm (2026 Q2) from C$698mm (2024 Q4); common shares rose to C$177mm from C$99mm (step-up in 2025 Q2)
Portfolio is public-market only per OSFI lines: no mortgages, no private placements, no real estate reported
Parent GA C$38.8bn (2025): 'mostly higher credit quality... private corporate bond allocations growing' (AM Best, Dec 2025)
Capital managed under a Board-approved Capital Risk Management Policy with internal LICAT ratios per OSFI A-4

rotation_commentary.text: No company commentary. OSFI data: total investments -19% (C$827mm to C$667mm, 2024 Q4 to 2026 Q2) as insurance liabilities ran off/were ceded; public corporate bonds -34%, common shares +80%.

Climate report: 'Portfolio monitoring and increased integration of climate considerations into investment decision-making' identified as an opportunity; no emissions targets; portfolio carbon reported internally.
Parent (AM Best): investment yield declining but trending up; losses on derivatives hedging variable products as rates rose; private corporates growing.

securities_lending.text: Not disclosed; no financial statements published. OSFI LF3 off-balance-sheet lines in the repo show no repo/securities-lending entries for this entity.

repos.text: None reported in OSFI LF3 extract.

structured_indirect.text: ABS, if any, sit inside OSFI 'corporate public' bonds (C$342mm) and cannot be separated. No CLO, fund-finance or funding-agreement exposure disclosed.
Reinsurance: Sun Life Sponsored Markets block came with reinsurance; reinsurance contract held assets C$57.3mm (2026 Q2).

leverage.note: No debt or hybrid capital issued by the Canadian entity. Tier 2 capital of C$60.3mm (2026 Q2) unexplained in public disclosure.

deals.text: Securian Financial acquired Canadian Premier Life and CRI Canada (now Valeyo) from ivari (closed 2017-04-03); AM Best affirmed A (Excellent) on close.
Acquired Gerber Life Insurance Company's Canadian block of business.
Acquired Armour Group (credit-protection distributor via auto/RV dealers and finance companies), Sept 2021; terms undisclosed.

Closed acquisition of Sun Life's Sponsored Markets (association & affinity, group creditor) business, 2023-02-01: 100+ client organizations, 1.5mm insureds; announced 2021-12-13; price and advisers undisclosed. Rebranded Canadian Premier + Valeyo as Securian Canada.
Launched fully digital insurance suite for the Canadian Automobile Association (7mm members), Jan 2024; sales 133% above target by mid-2025.
Creditor-insurance digital claims portal launched with an unnamed Tier 1 Canadian bank.

sponsorships.text: Official life insurance partner of the Canadian Football League (multi-year, from Feb 2023); presenting sponsor of CFL Diversity in Football program.
Official life insurance partner of the Toronto Maple Leafs and presenting sponsor of MLSE Foundation's Home Ice Hockey (announced 2024-09-19).
Sponsor of The Princess Margaret Cancer Foundation 2026 cricket event (May 2026); publishes annual 'Beyond Business' purpose report.

bank_relationships.text: Core model is bancassurance/creditor insurance: credit card balance protection and mortgage/loan protection distributed through Canadian banks, credit unions and finance companies (partners not named publicly).
Sun Life: seller of Sponsored Markets business (2023) and prior carrier for the transferred affinity clients.
No capital-markets issuance by the Canadian entity, so no dealer/bookrunner relationships.

appetite: Board-approved Risk Appetite Framework and internal capital targets (OSFI A-4); climate risk classified under Strategic Risk, assessed 'low'
Capital Risk Management Policy reviewed annually by the Board; goal is 'sufficient margin over' OSFI requirements
governance: Board oversees ERM, approves risk appetite policies and internal capital targets, reviews annual ORSA before OSFI submission
CRO leads independent risk function and chairs the Risk and Capital Committee (CEO + ELT, meets at least monthly); enterprise risks reported quarterly to RCC and Board
Climate Risk Working Group established 2024; three-lines model implied via internal audit input to ERM
risk.capital_target: LICAT total 157.3% / core 118.2% at 2026-06-30 vs supervisory targets 100% / 70%; company states ratios exceed internal capital ratios (figures not disclosed).

hedging: No hedging program disclosed at the Canadian entity; parent hedges variable-product guarantees with derivatives (AM Best)
Reinsurance held C$57mm (2026 Q2); individual-insurance reinsurance held is a net liability per LF3

H1 2026 net loss C$10.2mm; insurance revenue -7% in 2025 (C$915.9mm vs C$989.9mm)

notes: Canadian Premier Life (Securian Canada) is a C$1.1bn-asset Toronto creditor/affinity insurer owned by Securian Financial (AM Best A+ group). It is a disclosure-light entity: no statements, no investment officer, no named CRO. OSFI returns show a C$0.67bn public-market portfolio shrinking with the liability run-off, LICAT of 157% total / 118% core at Q2 2026, and a FY2025 net loss of C$106mm that coincides with C$96.5mm of goodwill leaving the balance sheet (inferred impairment, probably of the 2023 Sun Life Sponsored Markets goodwill). AM Best nevertheless affirmed A (Excellent) in Dec 2025 with BCAR at 'strongest'. CFO since March 2026 is Marc Peliel, ex-CEO of Humania. Personal library not available in this session; public sources used. WebSearch budget was exhausted before confirming Securian Asset Management's Canadian role or the CRO's name.
